At the 8th meeting of the International Economic Law and Policy Research Network, I gave a presentation titled "The Role of Competition Law and Policy in Human Resources (Competition in Services Provided by Individuals)."

This research was part of a joint research grant at Aoyama Gakuin University. There are no particular plans to publish this presentation as such, but I intend to build on it in articles on related topics.
